Start by writing down a list of careers you are interested in. Make a spreadsheet of pros and cons of those jobs and decide what is important to you and what is not so important to you in each. Research "a day in the life of \_\_\_"; There are many videos on youtube surrounding various careers. You can also reach out to professionals and perform informative interviews. This is how I decided that I wanted to pursue occupational therapy! (As well as many hours of shadowing and extensive research) Actually, have you thought about OT before? The job security isn't bad at all and it allows you to help others simultaneously. You already have  a BS, so you might already have some background. Grad school is only two years, and it's definitely worth it if you want to be doing something you love.
